model: full HTR-10 core, Şeker 13-ball bed N = 12 (123.576 cm), explicit TRISO, explicit reflector, rods withdrawn

TECDOC-1382 reflector zone 22, natural boron (benchmark default materials)
carbon: natural, C-12 / C-13 at 98.93 / 1.07 at.% (IUPAC)

rod metal: FULL: real Ni-58/60/61/62/64 and Fe-54/56/57/58
delta-tracked bed tallied with the TentativeCollision estimator (gh:#598)
hardware: CPU only, 4 cores, linux, Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 15.7 GiB RAM
